title: Feature handoff: pocket notes + evening checklist
content:
Evening pocket dump — short, messy, actionable. For follow-ups tomorrow and things to tuck into the PRD before final review.

MORNING CONTEXT (AM meetings):
- 09:00 1:1 w/ Marco: sync on canary capacity numbers; he wants default burst at 20% for first 48h.
- 10:30 infra sync (Danielle): confirm Dedicated node image (rwi-dedicated:2026-02-17) is green; noted a kernel warning in staging logs — low priority for launch but capture.
- 11:15 design review: small copy change for modal that asks for privacy consent — update samples in PRD.

TODAY'S QUICK GOALS:
- finalize PRD edits for rollout policy section (canary -> 10% -> 50% -> 100%).
- assemble launch checklist for AE handoff and CS playbook stub.
- confirm telemetry dashboard panels for latency distribution + token cost.

PRD EDITS (items to commit before tomorrow's review):
- Rollout policy: replace vague language with exact percent steps and time windows. New: canary=10% traffic for 4h, if errors <0.5% and median p95 latency < SLO then promote to 50% for 12h. Add explicit auto-fallback to lowest-latency model variant on region failure.
- Quotas: make the default dev quota 2M tokens/mo instead of 5M (matches new pricing conversation from finance).
- Observability: add section 'token-level tracing' and call out sample span ids for SDK ops.
- Team responsibilities: owner for post-launch regressions = Marco (primary), Aisha (product on-call), SRE on pager rotation.
- Acceptance criteria: add explicit smoke test list (see below).

SMOKE TESTS (to include in runbook):
- Basic generation endpoint: 5 concurrent requests, sequences of 128 tokens, expect <= 200ms p50 on dedicated pool (staging threshold).
- KV cache validation: request prefix twice, confirm second request served from cache (trace contains cache_hit=true).
- Fallback test: bring down region us-west-2 in staging routing table, confirm auto-route to us-east-1 within 45s and no client error >1%.
- Billing event emitted for each request chunk: check BillingTopic (topic: billing-usage-prod) receives event within 60s.

LAUNCH CHECKLIST (quick actionable):
- [ ] PRD final edits merged + PR link in handoff doc.
- [ ] Runbook uploaded to ops-runbooks/feature/handbook. (Sofia to confirm)
- [ ] Canary traffic controls configured in console (policy id?).
- [ ] Telemetry dashboards: latency, errors, token-cost, model-switch events. Dash IDs: pending.
- [ ] CS playbook draft: key phrases for customers and downgrade script.
- [ ] Post-launch eval prompts: 5 prompt sets for quality monitoring (templated in Optimize).

STAKEHOLDER FOLLOW-UPS (notes to send / Slack messages):
- Marco: confirm final burst config and whether we run extra hotpool for 6h after canary.
- Danielle: file kernel-warning follow-up ticket if it repeats; otherwise note for next maintenance window.
- Sofia (CS): ask for 3 customer-facing FAQs and the primary support contact for first 72h.
- Legal: send snippet of privacy consent modal copy for pre-approval (ETA 48h).

RISKS / OPEN QUESTIONS:
- If canary shows model quality regression, do we auto-roll back or auto-shift to quantized variant? Need decision: default rollback (yes) but add signal for manual override.
- Cost spike: what threshold (percent over baseline) triggers capacity throttle? currently undefined.
- Region-specific capacity: are we guaranteed spare capacity in eu-west-1 for weekend rollouts?

NOTES TO SELF / RANDOMS: 
- Consider including a short paragraph in PRD about developer experience for private customers (onboarding steps + network reqs).
- Revisit naming of rollout policy objects — current 'policy-alpha' is ugly. Rename to 'controlled-rollout-v1'.
- Add example of function/tool-calling payload to examples section so SDK folks can run smoke tests easily.

DECISIONS MADE TODAY (capture):
- Canary size set to 10% for 4h (agreed w/ Marco).
- Post-launch owner for immediate regressions = Marco.

ACTION ITEMS (next 48h):
- Aisha: merge PRD edits, attach PR link to this doc.
- Marco: configure canary and confirm hotpool decision.
- Sofia: assemble CS FAQs and initial playbook.
- Danielle: verify dedicated node image and escalate kernel warnings if recur.

MESSAGES / SLACK SNIPPETS (draft):
- @Marco — ran through canary plan this morning. Please confirm hotpool yes/no; if yes, set hotpool=6h and notify infra.
- @Sofia — can you draft 3 FAQs for customers (billing, SLOs, private deployments)? Need by EOD tomorrow.

BRIEF TIMELINE (rough):
- Day 0: PRD merge + runbook in ops.
- Day 1: Canary 10% (4h), monitoring watermark + smoke tests.
- Day 2: Promote 50% (12h) if criteria pass, keep tokens/cost checks on.

METRICS TO WATCH DURING CANARY:
- Error rate (5xx + client errors) per minute. Alert at >0.5%.
- Median and p95 latency. Alert p95 > SLO + 30%.
- Token cost per 1k tokens vs baseline. Alert >25% increase.
- Model switch count (unexpected model variant fallbacks).

SCRATCH: bits I want to remember to add to PRD later:
- Example observability trace with annotations for caching + function calls.
- Default example prompts for each customer vertical (saas, search, assistant).

END-OF-DAY QUICK REFLECTION:
- Progress: PRD structure tightened; most open items assigned.
- Risk: still fuzzy around cost-threshold actions and region capacity guarantees.
- Next: tidy PRD language + upload runbook before tomorrow standup.

UNRESOLVED JIRA / LINKS TO ADD (placeholders):
- JIRA:PROD-900 replace policy-alpha name (blocker-ish).
- GH PR: link to PRD edits (will paste once merged).
